scripts.a64:fuzz: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/fuzz.py; a=$?; echo '--- memory64 (30,000 cases) ---'; python3 test/a64/fuzz.py --mem64 --total 30000 --quiet; b=$?; echo '--- memory64, code and memory window above 4 GB (30,000 cases) ---'; python3 test/a64/fuzz.py --hi --total 30000 --quiet; c=$?; exit $((a|b|c))
scripts.a64:fuzz:mem64: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/fuzz.py --mem64 --quiet; a=$?; python3 test/a64/fuzz.py --hi --quiet; b=$?; exit $((a|b))
scripts.a64:guests: node test/a64/cache_stamp.mts && npm run -s a64:build && npm run -s a64:guests:build && node test/a64/guests_run.ts; a=$?; echo '--- again with budget=50 (forced preemption) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --budget 50 --quiet; b=$?; echo '--- again without wasm tail calls ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --notail --quiet; c=$?; echo '--- again on a shared memory (atomic exclusives) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --shared --quiet; d=$?; echo '--- memory64 (wasm64 translator, 64-bit memory) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --mem64 --quiet; f=$?; echo '--- memory64, images linked above 4 GB (code, data and stack at 0x1_8000_0000) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --mem64 --dir test/a64/guests/out_hi --quiet; g=$?; echo '--- memory64 above 4 GB, budget=50 ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --mem64 --dir test/a64/guests/out_hi --budget 50 --quiet; h=$?; echo '--- memory64 above 4 GB, shared memory ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --mem64 --dir test/a64/guests/out_hi --shared --quiet; i=$?; echo '--- memory64 above 4 GB, without wasm tail calls ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --mem64 --dir test/a64/guests/out_hi --notail --quiet; j=$?; echo '--- translator feature tests ---'; node test/a64/extra_run.ts; e=$?; echo '--- translator feature tests, memory64 ---'; node test/a64/extra_run.ts --mem64 --brief; k=$?; echo '--- translator feature tests, memory64, above 4 GB ---'; node test/a64/extra_run.ts --mem64 --high --brief; l=$?; echo '--- LSE atomics, several host threads on one shared memory ---'; node test/a64/lse_threads.ts; n=$?; node test/a64/lse_threads.ts --mem64; o=$?; echo '--- the wasm64 build tool (tools/asc64) ---'; node test/a64/asc64/run.mts --brief; m=$?; exit $((a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|i|j|k|l|m|n|o))
scripts.a64:bench: npm run -s a64:build && npm run -s a64:bench:build && node test/a64/bench/run.mts --mode all
scripts.a64:libc: npm run -s a64:build && npm run -s a64:bench:build && node test/a64/bench/libc_run.mts
scripts.a64:browser: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/guests/build_hi.py && esbuild test/a64/browser/worker.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/a64/browser/worker.js --log-level=warning && node test/a64/browser/run.ts
scripts.a64:big: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/guests/build.py --big && node test/a64/guests_run.ts --dir test/a64/guests/out_big --speed --mem

scripts.a64:extra: npm run -s a64:build && node test/a64/extra_run.ts; a=$?; node test/a64/extra_run.ts --mem64; b=$?; node test/a64/extra_run.ts --mem64 --high; c=$?; node test/a64/lse_threads.ts; d=$?; node test/a64/lse_threads.ts --mem64; e=$?; node test/a64/scan_run.ts --brief; f=$?; exit $((a|b|c|d|e|f))
